note: Chapter 2 is primarily a code-driven chapter per the course plan (real GRANT/REVOKE SQL as honest code cards, not claimed screenshots), with this lesson's one bonus real screenshot used because it maps directly onto the privilege names being taught. The GRANT syntax shape, the USE CATALOG/USE SCHEMA/SELECT three-privilege read requirement, the ALL PRIVILEGES exclusion list (MANAGE, READ METADATA, EXTERNAL USE SCHEMA, EXTERNAL USE LOCATION), and REVOKE syntax are all cross-checked directly against Databricks' official GRANT, SHOW GRANTS, and Unity Catalog permissions-model-concepts pages.
